name: Financial Expense & Spending Policy
description: Enforces corporate spending governance, approval limits, and prohibited operations across all enterprise workflows and agents.

rules.name: High Amount Human Authorization Gate
rules.reason: Transaction amount exceeds automatic autonomous approval threshold of R$ 10.000,00. Requires review and sign-off by a designated Human Operator or Admin.

rules.name: Restricted Financial Ledger Export
rules.reason: Direct export of full organizational financial ledger is strictly prohibited by security policy.
